states.name: containment
states.description: US to act with Containment: afterwards every US ops card is worth +1 (max 4) for the rest of the turn.

states.name: red-scare
states.description: USSR to act with Red Scare/Purge: afterwards every US ops card is worth -1 (min 1) for the rest of the turn.

states.name: nuclear-subs
states.description: US to act with Nuclear Subs: afterwards US coups in battlegrounds leave DEFCON alone this turn.

states.name: brezhnev-doctrine
states.description: USSR to act with Brezhnev Doctrine: afterwards every USSR ops card is worth +1 (max 4) this turn.

states.name: latin-american-death-squads
states.description: USSR to act with Latin American Death Squads: USSR coups in Central/South America get +1, US ones -1, this turn.

states.name: north-sea-oil
states.description: US to act with North Sea Oil, in the 6th of 6 action rounds: the US gets a 7th round of its own.

states.name: iran-contra-scandal
states.description: USSR to act with Iran-Contra Scandal: US realignment rolls get -1 for the rest of the turn.

states.name: yuri-and-samantha
states.description: USSR to act with Yuri and Samantha: the USSR gets 1 VP per US coup for the rest of the turn.

states.name: vietnam-revolts
states.description: USSR to act with Vietnam Revolts: +2 USSR in Vietnam, and +1 ops for a card spent wholly in Southeast Asia this turn.

states.name: chernobyl
states.description: US to act with Chernobyl: the US designates one region (digits 1-6) the USSR can't add influence to with ops this turn.

states.name: containment-active
states.description: Containment is in force; US to act holding Truman Doctrine (1 ops, worth 2) and Marshall Plan (4 ops, still 4). Italy US 1.

states.name: red-scare-active
states.description: Red Scare/Purge is in force against the US; US to act holding Truman Doctrine (1 ops, still 1) and Marshall Plan (4 ops, worth 3). Italy US 1.

states.name: containment-and-red-scare-active
states.description: Containment and Red Scare/Purge are both in force on the US: they cancel. US to act holding Marshall Plan (still 4). Italy US 1.

states.name: vietnam-revolts-active
states.description: Vietnam Revolts is in force; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops, worth 3 if spent wholly in Southeast Asia). Vietnam USSR 2, Thailand USSR 1, Poland USSR 1.

states.name: chernobyl-europe-active
states.description: Chernobyl bars the USSR from adding influence in Europe with ops; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). Poland USSR 2, Egypt USSR 1.

states.name: death-squads-active
states.description: Death Squads favour the USSR; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). Colombia US 2, Italy US 2 - a coup in the former gets +1, the latter nothing.

states.name: death-squads-against-active
states.description: Death Squads favour the USSR; US to act holding Marshall Plan (4 ops). Colombia USSR 2 - the US coup there rolls -1.

states.name: iran-contra-active
states.description: Iran-Contra is in force; US to act holding Marshall Plan (4 ops). Italy US 1 / USSR 1 for a realignment.

states.name: nuclear-subs-active
states.description: Nuclear Subs is in force, DEFCON 4; US to act holding Truman Doctrine (1 op). Iran USSR 3 - a battleground coup that leaves DEFCON alone.

states.name: us-battleground-coup
states.description: DEFCON 4, no Nuclear Subs; US to act holding Truman Doctrine (1 op). Iran USSR 3 - the battleground coup drops DEFCON to 3.

states.name: battleground-coup-defcon-2
states.description: DEFCON 2; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). Mexico US 3 - a battleground coup takes DEFCON to 1, a loss for the phasing USSR.

states.name: yuri-active
states.description: Yuri and Samantha is in force; US to act holding Truman Doctrine (1 op). Czechoslovakia USSR 2 - any US coup pays the USSR 1 VP.

states.name: north-sea-oil-final-round
states.description: North Sea Oil is in force in the 6th of 6 action rounds; US to act holding Truman Doctrine and Marshall Plan. After this the US plays a 7th round alone.
